title: Two-sided arguments without rebuttals
description: The same setting as debate, but the weak judge sees only an opening argument for each side, written without seeing the other, and no rebuttals. This tests whether hearing both sides is what helps the judge, as opposed to the debaters answering each other. Compared with consultancy (one consultant, random side). Qwen 3.5 397B argues, Gemma 4 31B judges.

source.title: Debating with More Persuasive LLMs Leads to More Truthful Answers
source.authors: Khan, Hughes, Valentine, Ruis, Sachan, Radhakrishnan, Grefenstette, Bowman, Rocktäschel, Perez
